subject: Four equal cream rounded app tiles arranged in a 2 by 2 grid
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one decorative Hito DS Hub navigation PNG, matching an already accepted eight-icon family.
Input image is the accepted FAMILY STYLE REFERENCE, not the desired subject. Change ONLY its central house emblem to a simple app-launcher grid: FOUR equal cream rounded square tiles in an orderly 2 by 2 grid with generous equal orange gaps. No roof, house, slider, book, triangle or circles. Each tile is softly domed, opaque cream polymer and embossed on the carrier. Grid should read clearly at 64 pixels.
Preserve the reference's orange rounded-square carrier silhouette, exact framing and optical size, front-right perspective, satin material, upper-left soft light, soft lower-right contact shadow and transparent exterior. Keep the same camera and thickness. A single isolated icon only, no letters/text, no background, floor plane or extra embellishment. True alpha PNG, square, at least 1024px. The Hub navigation subject is separate from other service emblems.
Follow this canonical recipe without restyling it:
{
  "id": "hito-hub-soft-3d-icons",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "purpose": "Reusable image-generation art direction for a coherent family of decorative PNG service icons in the Hito DS Hub.",
  "language": "en",
  "approval": "Style recipe requested by Ivan; generated examples and adoption remain subject to visual review.",
  "reference_analysis": {
    "reference": "User-supplied Screenshot 2026-10-06 at 22.10.39.png",
    "observed_subject": "A thick coral-red rounded speech-bubble plaque with a smaller raised pale cream heart on its front face.",
    "transferable_style": "A single compact, sculptural 3D icon with inflated but controlled volume, generous continuous rounding, satin polymer surfaces, broad soft highlights and gentle contact shadows. Friendly, tactile and clean, like a carefully made miniature design object.",
    "transferable_geometry": "Broad nearly flat front face, softly crowned edges, thick rounded sidewalls and a raised rounded emblem. The front dominates; the right side and a narrow top edge reveal depth.",
    "do_not_transfer": [
      "The coral-red reference color; replace it with the Hito DS brand palette below.",
      "The heart or speech-bubble tail unless the supplied service icon actually contains those features.",
      "The white screenshot background, browser controls, cropped Visit site label or screenshot edges."
    ],
    "measurement_note": "Camera angles, material numbers and relative dimensions below are proposed consistency targets inferred from appearance, not recovered measurements of the original render."
  },
  "inputs": {
    "service_id": "{{service_id}}",
    "service_name": "{{service_name}}",
    "source_icon": "{{attach_source_icon}}",
    "symbol_description": "{{brief_description_of_the_service_symbol}}",
    "input_priority": "Use the attached source icon as the authority for symbol identity, silhouette, orientation, important openings and recognizable parts. Use this JSON as the authority for visual treatment and palette.",
    "if_no_source_icon": "Use symbol_description as the subject specification. Do not invent service capabilities, text or additional symbols.",
    "optional_style_reference": "Attach the original style reference as a secondary image when available; it supplies material and lighting only, not the service subject."
  },
  "palette": {
    "canonical_source": "packages/design-system/tokens/reference-colors.mjs",
    "role": "Existing corporate palette samples for rendered artwork, not new UI semantic tokens.",
    "body_base": { "token": "color/brand/500", "hex": "#F4A34B" },
    "body_lit_planes": { "token": "color/brand/400", "hex": "#FBB367" },
    "body_soft_highlight": { "token": "color/brand/300", "hex": "#FEC589" },
    "body_side_shadow": { "token": "color/brand/600", "hex": "#D88015" },
    "body_deep_contact": { "token": "color/brand/700", "hex": "#B26402" },
    "raised_symbol_base": { "token": "color/neutral/50", "hex": "#F6F3EE" },
    "raised_symbol_warm_bounce": { "token": "color/brand/100", "hex": "#FDE7CF" },
    "raised_symbol_shadow": { "token": "color/neutral/100", "hex": "#F0EAE5" },
    "cast_shadow_tint": { "token": "color/neutral/1000", "hex": "#0E0C0F" },
    "application": [
      "Use brand500 as the recognizable dominant orange surface; do not replace it with the separate orange500 or red families.",
      "Use cream for the raised service symbol, with restrained warm reflected light from the orange body.",
      "Use darker brand shades on receding sidewalls and in contact occlusion, not as a black outline.",
      "Color variation must follow volume and illumination. Do not apply a decorative multicolor gradient.",
      "Keep the same color roles for every service. Do not assign unrelated colors to different services."
    ],
    "rendering_note": "Hex values describe material/albedo targets. Shading and antialiasing necessarily produce intermediate pixel colors; a generated PNG is not an exact token swatch."
  },
  "shape_language": {
    "family_construction": "A brand-orange rounded plaque carrying one raised cream service emblem. Keep this construction consistent across the Hub icon family.",
    "carrier": {
      "default": "A thick rounded-square plaque with a clean continuous silhouette and no speech tail.",
      "source_specific_extension": "Include a speech tail or other distinctive carrier extension only when it belongs to the input symbol. Round it into the main body with the same material and edge treatment.",
      "front_face": "Broad and mostly planar with a subtle cushion-like crown, never a sphere or a deeply inflated pillow.",
      "corner_radius_fraction_of_front_width": 0.23,
      "thickness_fraction_of_front_width": 0.16,
      "edge_roll": "Wide smooth bevel rolling continuously from front face into sidewall; no stepped chamfer, sharp seam or thin extruded vector edge.",
      "surface_integrity": "One solid molded object, with no seams, stitching, cracks, holes or mechanical fasteners unless essential to the input symbol."
    },

      "width_fraction_of_front_width": [0.50, 0.62],
      "height_fraction_of_front_height_max": 0.65,
      "relief_depth_fraction_of_front_width": [0.05, 0.08],
      "form": "A solid, gently domed cream relief with rounded edges and convincing thickness, visibly attached to the orange front.",
      "source_translation": "Preserve the input icon's identity and main negative spaces. Turn thin outline strokes into smooth rounded solid bands where needed for readability; keep their topology and proportions recognizable.",
      "detail_budget": "One main symbol with at most two essential secondary parts. Remove decorative microdetail, but never a feature that changes the symbol's meaning.",
      "contact": "A narrow soft occlusion shadow immediately beneath the relief, strongest along lower-right edges. No uniform black border or floating gap.",
      "avoid_duplicate_carrier": "If the source symbol already is a speech bubble or rounded tile with an inner symbol, use that silhouette as the carrier. Do not place a second miniature plaque on the first."

    "subsurface_effect": "Extremely subtle warm softening at thin edges, if used; no wax translucency or internal glow.",
    "surface_texture": "Almost invisible fine matte grain at full resolution. No visible clay fingerprints, paper fibers, brush strokes, scratches or pronounced noise.",
    "specular": "Broad low-contrast highlight along the upper-left bevel and a soft highlight on the raised emblem; no pinpoints, mirror reflections or hard white streaks."
  },
  "camera": {
    "projection": "Orthographic or a long-lens perspective approximation with negligible perspective distortion.",
    "view": "Three-quarter front view with the right sidewall visible and a little of the top visible; the front symbol remains easy to recognize.",
    "approximate_yaw_degrees": 20,
    "approximate_elevation_degrees": 12,
    "roll_degrees": 0,
    "screen_space_orientation": "Top edges recede slightly downward toward the right, matching the supplied reference; avoid mirroring the view between services.",
    "depth_of_field": "Entire icon sharply resolved. No cinematic foreground or background blur.",
    "consistency": "Lock the camera, apparent object scale and orientation after the first accepted example; reuse them for every service."
  },
  "lighting": {
    "key": "One large diffused area light above, in front of and to the left of the icon.",
    "direction_in_image": "Upper-left highlights, softly shaded right and lower planes, shadows falling toward lower right.",
    "fill": "Weak neutral studio fill preserves detail in the darker sidewall without flattening the form.",
    "bounce": "A restrained warm orange reflection from the carrier onto the underside of the cream emblem.",
    "contrast": "Moderate, with smooth continuous transitions; no dramatic spotlights or crushed recesses.",
    "rim_light": "None as a separate luminous outline. Edge readability should come from rounded geometry and broad soft illumination.",
    "cast_shadow": {
      "enabled": true,
      "description": "A small soft grounding shadow below and slightly to the right of the icon, suggesting it hovers just above an invisible surface.",
      "opacity_target": [0.08, 0.16],
      "edge": "Diffuse and smoothly fading to alpha zero; never a hard ellipse.",
      "extent": "Keep the entire shadow within the transparent safe margin.",
      "no_floor": "Render only the shadow's translucent pixels, without a visible plane, white matte, pedestal or backdrop."
    }
  },
  "composition": {
    "canvas": "Square",
    "object_count": 1,
    "alignment": "Optically centered, allowing a little space below and right for the shadow.",
    "object_longest_dimension_fraction_of_canvas": [0.78, 0.82],
    "minimum_transparent_margin_fraction": 0.08,
    "crop": "Entire object, carrier extensions and cast shadow visible; no clipped extremities.",
    "text": "No text, service names, letters, numbers, wordmarks, badges or watermarks baked into the image.",
    "scene": "An isolated icon only, without people, environmental props or narrative scenery."
  },
  "output": {
    "format": "PNG",
    "color_mode": "RGBA",
    "color_space": "sRGB",
    "preferred_canvas_px": { "width": 1024, "height": 1024 },
    "background": "True alpha transparency, not a white background and not a painted checkerboard.",
    "object_opacity": "Carrier and emblem are opaque. Only edge antialiasing and the external cast shadow use partial alpha.",
    "edge_quality": "Clean antialiased edges with no white matte, colored fringe, jagged pixels or glow.",
    "filename_template": "hub-{{service_id}}-soft-3d-v1.png",
    "generation_unit": "Generate one service icon per image, never a contact sheet or several alternative icons in one PNG.",
    "resolution_note": "Request the preferred canvas where supported; inspect actual output dimensions. Do not claim a specific delivered size without checking the file."
  },
  "theme_compatibility": {
    "strategy": "Use the same opaque orange-and-cream artwork on light and dark Hub surfaces.",
    "light_review_background": { "token": "color/neutral/50", "hex": "#F6F3EE" },
    "dark_review_backgrounds": [
      { "token": "color/neutral/950", "hex": "#201E23" },
      { "token": "color/neutral/1000", "hex": "#0E0C0F" }
    ],
    "rules": [
      "Do not invert the image for dark mode.",
      "Cream is a solid material fill, never transparent cutout artwork.",
      "The silhouette must remain readable even when the translucent cast shadow is barely visible on dark surfaces.",
      "Do not bake review backgrounds into the PNG."
    ]
  },
  "negative_prompt": [
    "coral red or pink body",
    "unrelated rainbow palette",
    "flat vector rendering or thin outline icon",
    "sharp extrusion, angular bevels, faceted low-poly geometry",
    "glass, jelly, translucent wax, chrome or metal",
    "wet candy gloss, mirror reflections, sparkle or lens flare",
    "hard black outlines or comic shading",
    "extreme balloon inflation or melted shapes",
    "grainy clay, fingerprints, brush strokes or distressed texture",
    "complex scene, extra props, confetti or decorative particles",
    "speech tail or heart added to unrelated service symbols",
    "text, letters, watermark or UI screenshot elements",
    "white rectangle, paper background, floor plane or visible checkerboard",
    "heavy drop shadow, black halo or luminous border",
    "wide-angle distortion, inconsistent viewpoint or shallow depth of field",
    "clipped edges, tiny unreadable symbol or multiple icons in one image"

  "generation": {
    "usage": "Attach this JSON and a source icon. Fill service_id, service_name and symbol_description. Ask for one transparent PNG. Keep all other sections fixed across the series.",

Use #F4A34B for the dominant orange body and #F6F3EE for the solid cream emblem, with only the specified brand and neutral shading colors. Center the complete icon with consistent scale and generous margins. Include a small soft lower-right grounding shadow on genuine alpha transparency. No background, floor, text, extra objects or watermark. Deliver a single square RGBA PNG, preferably 1024×1024. Follow the JSON's negative_prompt and validation rules.",
    "series_reference": "After Ivan accepts the first generated icon, attach that accepted PNG as an additional style reference for subsequent services. Keep the new service's source icon as the separate identity reference.",

    "All icons share camera direction, apparent scale, bevel softness, material and lighting.",

    "Inspect at 1024px for artifacts and at 128px and 64px for silhouette and symbol readability; do not assume suitability as a 16px functional glyph.",
    "Review on the specified light and dark backgrounds without changing the asset itself.",
    "Nothing is cropped, and the shadow fades cleanly before reaching the canvas edge.",
    "No baked-in text, service claim, watermark, accidental extra symbol or screenshot UI remains.",
    "Treat camera/material consistency and palette matching as review criteria, not guarantees supplied by the generator."
  ]
